title: What the Mountain Pygmy Possum saves

is_this_you.pressure: Cornered, you move house before you argue. Two boulders over, the cold is steadier, and nobody saw you go.
is_this_you.love: You will cross a road built to keep you out if the one you want lives on the other side.
is_this_you.cost: You stock the den in autumn, then barely touch it. Saving becomes the point, and the winter gets thin.

opener.text: In August 1966, skiers on Mt Hotham found a strange-looking rat in their hut [s11]. Norman Wakefield studied it [s11]. Science had known the species only from a fossil jaw in a small block of limestone, described in the 1890s and written off as extinct [s11] [s6]. The skiers' find was alive, and it got a name: George [s11]. You were born a Capricorn in a Rabbit year. You have been counted out early before, and you were tucked in somewhere, breathing.

howto: Three parts. Small ones. Open any crack first.

tabs.label: Back from stone
tabs.intro: Saturn's long count. The Rabbit's soft caution.

rows.text: Capricorn is cardinal Earth, ruled by Saturn, patient and good with money [s1] [s2]. The Rabbit is yin Wood, gentle and alert, and slow to show its mind [s3] [s4]. In you the two make a careful planner with something soft kept under the rock.

The possum weighs about 45 grams [s6] [s7]. It is the only Australian mammal restricted to alpine and subalpine habitat, and it lives mainly in boulderfields [s6] [s10]. Your own world is small on purpose. You know every crack in it, and which ones hold.

tabs.label: The long sleep
tabs.intro: Five to seven months under the snow.

rows.text: Mountain pygmy possums start hibernating around April, months before the snow, and wake when it melts [s8] [s9]. In torpor their bodies drop to about 2°C [s8]. Your body reads the turn of a season before the mountain admits it. You shut the door early and sleep well.

In winter they walk out for up to five days at a stretch, and they change dens up to 12 times a season [s8]. The Chinese say 狡兔三窟 (jiǎo tù sān kū), the crafty rabbit keeps three burrows, from Feng Xuan's advice in the Zhanguo Ce [s5]. You keep twelve. From outside it looks like worry. You call it checking.
According to Menkhorst (1995), it is the only marsupial known to cache non-perishable food [s7]. You stock early and store where nobody else would look. Those stores were meant to be eaten.
Supply planning, actuarial work and seed banks all pay for foresight. Name the problem out loud before you move dens.

tabs.label: Who crosses the road for you
tabs.intro: Three who winter the way you do. One from the open sky.
tabs.love_lead: In love you commit slowly, and the Rabbit stays faithful once it does [s2] [s4]. You need someone who does not take a long winter silence personally. Three of the old Chinese pairings fit.

easy.why: The Clark's Nutcracker (Virgo, Goat year) sits in your Rabbit, Goat and Pig trine, on the same Earth footing [s3] [s1].
The Snow Leopard (Scorpio, Goat year) is trine kin from high boulder country, and Scorpio's Water softens Capricorn's ground [s3] [s1].
The Tibetan Blue Bear (Capricorn, Dog year) shares your sign, and the Dog is the Rabbit's secret friend [s3].

hard.why: The hard one is the Emperor Penguin (Cancer, Rooster year): the Rooster is the Rabbit's clash, and Cancer faces Capricorn across the zodiac [s3] [s1].

story.text: Under the Great Alpine Road near Mt Hotham runs a rock-filled corridor, first built in the 1980s, so males can reach the females higher up [s12] [s6]. Genetic work had found the road was a major barrier to breeding [s12]. People call it the tunnel of love [s12].

closing: Let them write you off. One day someone opens the hut door and finds you breathing.
